senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עוּף I)fainting, wearied; exhausted. Pesik. Zakhor, p. 28ᵃ (ref. to Deut. XXV, 18) ע׳ בצמא faint from thirst; Tanḥ. Ki Thetse 10; a. e.—Pl. עֲיֵפִים, עֲיֵפִין, עֲיֵי׳.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 19:5">Ex. R. s. 19</cite> <he>מפני שהיו ע׳ מן הריח</he> because they were fainting from the smell (of the Passover sacrifice).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 94b:8">Snh. 94ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 8:23">Is. VIII, 23</cite>) <he>אין נמסר עַם ע׳ בתורה ביד מי המציק לו</he> the people (of Judah) that studies the Law with painstaking shall not be delivered into the hands of him who distresses it.
